sloka: ते दृष्ट्वा देवसङ्काशं कृतपादाभिवन्दनम् ।राघवं सुदुराधर्षमाशीर्भिः समपूजयन् ।। ७.९१.५ ॥
transliteration: te dṛṣṭvā devasaṅkāśaṁ kṛtapādābhivandanam ।rāghavaṁ sudurādharṣamāśīrbhiḥ samapūjayan ।। 7.91.5 ॥

translations.english: Having seen Rama, who was god-like, very difficult to overcome, and had just bowed at their feet, they honored him with their blessings.
